column1: # v7b smoke test (2026-10-18; analysis/v7b-fixes.md): scripted mockllm agents (scripts/smoke_v7b.py), no model spend. m7a boxes as make_v7_plan writes them, the v7 flags with a token budget (mockllm has no price), two groups so the driver must hold the first group's selection until the second row ends.
